No. Both the Official Policy Standard and the Regulatory Compliance Guidelines state that **only designated Corporate Communications spokespersons are authorized to speak on behalf of the company to journalists, media outlets, or on social media**.  

If you are not one of those spokespersons, you must **direct any media interview requests to press@company.com** (as noted in the archived informational note).  

Employees who do post on personal social channels about company matters must include the disclaimer “Views expressed are my own,” but posting unreleased features would still be outside the allowed scope unless you are an authorized spokesperson.
